_comment: D-16. FR-28: edit this file to change what a persona shows. No agent code reads persona logic; the stack is identical across all five.

rows.label: Fisherman
rows.answer_framing: Direct and practical. Lead with the verdict and the turn-back time.
suggested_queries: Is it safe to go out tomorrow morning?
What about the day after?
And for the 12 m trawler?
Where is the nearest fishing zone?

rows.label: Disaster Mgmt
rows.answer_framing: Population and exposure first. State how many registered boats are affected and the release state.
suggested_queries: Which boats are at risk tomorrow?
Show me the alert backlog awaiting release
What is the worst crossing window this week?
How many boats does a DO_NOT_CROSS affect?

rows.label: Coast Guard
rows.answer_framing: Operational. Give bearings, corridor and turn-back time; flag zone breaches explicitly.
suggested_queries: Plot a corridor to Wadge Bank
Which zones does this ground touch?
What is the turn-back time for a 9 m FRP?
Is any boat inside a restricted zone?

rows.label: Policy Maker
rows.answer_framing: Aggregate and comparative. Lead with days-per-year flagged and cost per bulletin.
suggested_queries: How many days a year would this close the bar?
What does a bulletin cost to deliver?
How does the index compare to the naive baseline?
What share of alerts reach a boat with no phone?

rows.label: Researcher
rows.answer_framing: Method-forward. Name the sources, the weights and the caveats before the conclusion.
suggested_queries: Show the chlorophyll anomaly for this season
What drives the hazard index on this date?
Which sources were attempted and substituted?
Where is the index weakest?
